gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.129394 40.086172)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.129394 40.086172)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-96.701366 40.848198)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-96.701366 40.848198)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ABS(p1.elev - p2.elev) AS elevation_difference_m,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

elevations AS (

    ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM 
    points_of_interest p

    public.dem_us r
  ON 
    ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326), r.rast)
)

FROM 
  elevations e1
JOIN 
  elevations e2
ON
